entries.summary: Real-world code editing is dismal — 4.9% on the Aider polyglot board, near the bottom, despite a respectable-looking HumanEval. Snippet benchmarks flatter it; repository work exposes it.

mitigations.note: Use a Qwen3 model for coding. Gemma's lane is chat, languages, writing, and vision.

entries.summary: No native function-calling tokens or template — tool use rides on prompt-following, which works surprisingly well but breaks more than trained-in tool calling.

mitigations.note: Give exact JSON schemas with examples in the system prompt — community benchmarks show it follows them decently.
For heavy MCP/agent work, pick a model with trained-in tool calling.

entries.summary: Family-wide tendency to hallucinate names and specific factual details; HHEM (7.4%) is oddly worse than the 4B.

mitigations.note: Ground factual work; treat unsourced names/dates with suspicion.
